data.export_transformation: Original578observations retained in the original row order;only column names and record-object serialization are changed. No endpoint,baseline cohort,missingness label or expected outcome was precomputed in the public source.
data.endpoint_policy: At day21 summarize only the chicks actually measured at that exact day. Retention denominator is all unique chicks with a day0 record in the same diet. Do not replace missing day21 values by last observed weights,carry them forward as survivors,or infer death or withdrawal causes. Diet labels are historical source labels,not recommendations.
